claims.claim_text: The indexed Theodore F. Astrella is very likely Theodore Fox Astrella, the wartime Army engineer officer associated with the Engineer School at Fort Belvoir.
claims.evidence_excerpt: the engineer school at Fort Belvoir, Va., sent Major Theodore F. Astrella as special demolitions consultant
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A contemporary unit history places the uncommon exact name in an October 1942 Army engineer role, and an official federal record supplies the full middle name.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: uncommon exact name, expanded middle name, Army branch, officer status, and wartime chronology align across two independent records; neither outside source directly reproduces the OSS index or Box 24 linkage.
claims.temporal_assessment: The unit history dates the Fort Belvoir Engineer School role to October 1942, but the date of Astrella's OSS entry is not established, so this duty is not labeled immediate pre-OSS.
claims.match_notes: The identity is published at high confidence. The Army role is identity and occupation context only; no civilian employer or immediate predecessor is claimed.
